workflow_metadata.name: schema_approval
workflow_metadata.description: Schema approval workflow with multi-stage review process

tasks.name: repeat_until_approved
tasks.description: Loop that repeats until workflow variable 'approved' is true
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to Python while loop. Check $.approved condition each iteration. May need continue-as-new if iterations exceed 100.

tasks.name: upload_schema
tasks.description: Simple task to upload schema for review
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. First task in DO_WHILE loop.

tasks.name: fork_join
tasks.description: Parallel execution of Review1.a and Review1.b
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to asyncio.gather() with two parallel activity executions. Execute Review1.a and Review1.b concurrently.

tasks.name: Review1.a
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes in parallel with Review1.b inside asyncio.gather().

tasks.name: Review1.b
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes in parallel with Review1.a inside asyncio.gather().

tasks.name: notification_join
tasks.description: Join/synchronization point waiting for Review1.a and Review1.b to complete
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: No explicit translation needed. asyncio.gather() automatically waits for all parallel tasks to complete. JOIN is implicit in the await.

tasks.name: Review1Check
tasks.description: Conditional check based on user approval decision from Review1

input_parameters.expression: if (both approved) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: CRITICAL: This SWITCH references ${user_action.output.approved}, indicating human interaction. Translate to if/elif/else checking self._user_action.approved after receiving Update or Signal from external system. NO case is empty (no tasks), YES case proceeds to Review2.

tasks.name: Review2
tasks.description: Second review stage (executes if Review1 approved)
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes inside YES branch of Review1Check conditional.

tasks.name: Review2Check
tasks.description: Conditional check after Review2 to determine if Review3 is needed

input_parameters.expression: if (skippReview3) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: CRITICAL: Nested SWITCH inside Review1Check YES branch. References ${user_action.output.approved} for human interaction. YES branch completes review, NO branch proceeds to Review3. This is a nested conditional (nesting level 3).

tasks.name: CompleteReview
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes inside Review2Check YES branch. Note: Same task name used in two locations with different reference names (CompleteReview_1 and CompleteReview_2).

tasks.name: Review3
tasks.description: Third review stage (executes if Review2Check requires additional review)
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes inside Review2Check NO branch (deeply nested).

tasks.name: Review3Check
tasks.description: Conditional check after Review3 for final approval

input_parameters.expression: if (approved) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: CRITICAL: Deeply nested SWITCH (level 4). References ${user_action.output.approved} for human interaction. YES completes review, NO has empty case (loop continues at DO_WHILE level).

tasks.name: CompleteReview
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. Executes inside Review3Check YES branch. Note: Same task name as CompleteReview_1 but different reference name (CompleteReview_2). Maximum nesting depth of workflow.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor task. Consider adding timeout in Temporal implementation.
human_interaction_patterns.notes: SWITCH task checking external user approval after parallel Review1.a and Review1.b complete. This is the first approval gate. Recommend Update with validation to ensure only authorized reviewers can approve.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor task. Consider adding timeout in Temporal implementation.
human_interaction_patterns.notes: Nested SWITCH checking whether to skip Review3 or proceed. References same ${user_action.output.approved} pattern. This is the second approval gate determining if additional review is needed.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor task. Consider adding timeout in Temporal implementation.
human_interaction_patterns.notes: Deeply nested SWITCH (level 4) checking final approval after Review3. References same ${user_action.output.approved} pattern. This is the third and final approval gate before workflow completes or loops back.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No max iterations specified. Consider adding max iteration limit to prevent infinite loops.
human_interaction_patterns.notes: DO_WHILE loop that continues until $.approved is true. The entire review process (upload, parallel reviews, nested conditionals) repeats until final approval. The 'approved' variable is likely set by CompleteReview tasks. Consider implementing continue-as-new if loop iterations exceed 100 to prevent workflow history bloat.

complexity_factors: DO_WHILE loop containing entire review process (potential for many iterations)
FORK_JOIN with 2 parallel branches inside loop
Multiple human interaction points requiring external input (${user_action.output.approved})
Same task name (CompleteReview) used in two different locations with different reference names
Loop condition depends on workflow variable 'approved' which is not explicitly set in visible tasks
Complex approval flow with conditional branching at each stage

recommended_patterns.human_interaction: Updates recommended for all 3 approval checkpoints (Review1Check, Review2Check, Review3Check). Each Update should validate reviewer authorization and return immediate feedback. The DO_WHILE loop indicates an approval-retry pattern where the entire review process repeats until final approval is granted.
recommended_patterns.error_handling: Retry policies recommended for all SIMPLE tasks (upload_schema, Review1.a, Review1.b, Review2, Review3, CompleteReview_1, CompleteReview_2) as they represent external operations that may fail transiently.
recommended_patterns.parallel_execution: asyncio.gather recommended for FORK_JOIN executing Review1.a and Review1.b in parallel. Both must complete before proceeding to Review1Check.
recommended_patterns.loop_handling: Continue-as-new strongly recommended if DO_WHILE iterations exceed 100 to prevent workflow event history bloat. Consider adding max iteration limit (e.g., 10) to prevent infinite loops. Each iteration includes parallel execution and multiple conditional branches.
special_considerations: The 'approved' workflow variable must be set by CompleteReview activities to exit the DO_WHILE loop. This is not explicitly shown in the Conductor JSON - ensure CompleteReview activities set this variable in Temporal implementation.
All SWITCH tasks reference ${user_action.output.approved}, suggesting a consistent pattern for receiving approval decisions. Consider creating a shared ApprovalDecision dataclass.
The workflow has NO explicit workflow inputs (inputParameters is empty array). Consider adding workflow input for initial submission data.
Task name 'CompleteReview' is reused with different reference names (CompleteReview_1, CompleteReview_2). In Temporal, these should be the same activity function called from different code paths.

Review2Check expression mentions 'skippReview3' which suggests a business rule for conditionally skipping Review3 based on certain criteria - this logic needs to be implemented in the approval decision.
The deeply nested structure (5 levels) makes the workflow complex to test and debug. Consider helper methods in workflow class to manage each review stage separately.
No timeout configuration present. Add timeouts for all activities and human interaction wait conditions to prevent indefinite blocking.

translation_notes: This workflow represents a complex multi-stage approval process with retry-until-approved semantics.
The DO_WHILE loop wraps the entire review process, meaning if approval is not granted at any stage, the entire process restarts from upload_schema.

Three separate approval checkpoints (Review1Check, Review2Check, Review3Check) all reference ${user_action.output.approved}, suggesting they may be checking different approval decisions or the same decision from different reviewers.
The workflow has empty inputParameters and outputParameters arrays - consider defining explicit input/output contracts for better type safety in Temporal.

The 'approved' workflow variable referenced in the DO_WHILE loop condition ($.approved) must be set somewhere to exit the loop. This is likely set by CompleteReview tasks but not explicitly shown in the JSON.
Consider implementing workflow queries to allow external systems to check current approval status and review stage.
The parallel execution of Review1.a and Review1.b suggests two independent reviewers must both complete their reviews before proceeding.
Review2Check has a conditional path that can skip Review3 entirely (YES branch goes to CompleteReview_1), suggesting an expedited approval path for certain scenarios.
Maximum nesting depth of 5 is at the upper limit of maintainable complexity. Consider refactoring into helper methods for each review stage.
No error handling or compensation logic is visible in the Conductor JSON. Consider adding error handling for activity failures in Temporal implementation.
The workflow is marked as restartable=true, indicating it can be restarted from the beginning if needed.
